name: name
doc: stable id, default the kebab-case class name

name: description
doc: one line shown on the strategy card (default: the docstring)

name: universe
doc: list of instrument ids, or Screener(...)

name: timeframe
doc: "1m" "5m" "15m" "1H" "4H" "1D", or Timeframe("4H") to let instances choose

name: can_long
doc: the strategy may open longs (default True)

name: can_short
doc: the strategy may open shorts (default True)

name: warmup
doc: bars of history the strategy reads

name: schedule
doc: {"name": "15m"}: on_timer(ctx, "name") every 15 minutes

name: on_start
doc: Once after the process starts or restarts (ctx.state is restored).

name: on_bar
doc: One confirmed bar of one universe instrument (bar.inst bar.ts bar.o bar.h bar.l bar.c bar.vol bar.volq).

name: on_bars
doc:
All universe bars that closed at one time, {inst: Bar}. Override it to rank instruments
against each other; the default calls on_bar for each one.

name: on_timer
doc: A timer from `schedule` is due.

name: on_universe_change
doc: A Screener universe changed; ctx.universe is current.

name: on_fill
doc: A fill of this instance (fill.inst_id fill.pos_side fill.side fill.qty fill.px fill.kind …).

name: on_position_closed
doc:
A position of this instance closed: trade.inst_id trade.pos_side trade.exit_px trade.kind
(fill = by a signal, stop, target, time, liquidation) and trade.pnl (the closing fill's
realized PnL minus its fee; earlier partial closes, entry fees and funding are not included).

name: on_signal_result
doc: result.signal_id result.outcome (ordered rejected skipped_ai …) result.reason.

name: on_funding
doc: Funding settled on a position.

name: on_stop
doc: Before the process exits.

name: status
doc: One short line shown on the instance card ("BTC: fast above slow, waiting"), or None.

name: allows
doc:
Whether this instance may open `side` ("long" / "short"): the class's can_long / can_short and,
when the strategy declares one, its `direction` parameter (long / short / both).

name: Int
sig: (default: 'int', min: 'float | None' = None, max: 'float | None' = None, step: 'float | None' = 1, **kw)
doc: A whole number: Int(20, min=5, max=100).

name: Float
sig: (default: 'float', min: 'float | None' = None, max: 'float | None' = None, step: 'float | None' = None, **kw)
doc: A decimal number: Float(2.0, min=0.5, max=6, step=0.25).

name: Bool
doc: A switch: Bool(True). Reads as True / False.

name: Choice
doc:
One of a fixed list of strings: Choice("both", ["long", "short", "both"]). Reads as the string.

labels (optional) are the names shown in the form, one per option.

name: Timeframe
doc: The bar timeframe as a parameter, so each instance can pick it: timeframe = Timeframe("4H").

name: Param
sig: (default: 'Any', min: 'float | None' = None, max: 'float | None' = None, step: 'float | None' = None, desc: 'str' = '', ai_tunable: 'bool' = False, group: 'str' = '', label: 'str' = '')
doc:
A numeric parameter (int when the default is an int). Read it as `self.<name>` in handlers.

Every parameter type shares group (form section), label (display name), desc (help text) and
ai_tunable (the AI layer may propose changes, applied only after the owner approves them).
On the wire every value is a number; subclasses map it to their own type.

name: Screener
sig: (rule: 'str' = '', side: 'str' = 'long', top: 'int' = 20, min_score: 'float | None' = None, filter: 'dict[str, tuple[float, float]] | None' = None, refresh: 'str' = '1H', scope: 'str' = 'pool')
doc:
Dynamic universe re-evaluated every `refresh`.

scope="pool" (default): the active pool, ranked by a rule's score on `side` (long | short | both,
the stronger side), else by pool rank; top 1–50.
scope="market": every recorded crypto USDT swap ranked by 12h USDT turnover, descending; top 1–300.
No rule or min_score (scores exist only for pool rows); `filter` still applies.

name: open
sig: (inst: 'str', side: 'str', stop_loss: 'Level' = None, take_profit: 'Level' = None, strength: 'float' = 1.0, leverage: 'float | None' = None, max_slippage_bp: 'float | None' = None, ttl_ms: 'int | None' = None, trailing_stop: 'Level' = None, time_limit: 'Union[str, int, None]' = None, reason: 'str' = '')
doc:
Open (or add to) a position on `side` ("long" / "short").

stop_loss / take_profit: a price, "<k>atr" (k × ATR(14) of the strategy timeframe from the
reference price) or "<k>%". trailing_stop: a distance that follows the best price (the stop only
tightens). time_limit: close after "30m" / "6h" / "2d".

name: open_long
sig: (inst: 'str', stop_loss: 'Level' = None, take_profit: 'Level' = None, strength: 'float' = 1.0, leverage: 'float | None' = None, max_slippage_bp: 'float | None' = None, ttl_ms: 'int | None' = None, reason: 'str' = '', trailing_stop: 'Level' = None, time_limit: 'Union[str, int, None]' = None)

name: open_short
sig: (inst: 'str', stop_loss: 'Level' = None, take_profit: 'Level' = None, strength: 'float' = 1.0, leverage: 'float | None' = None, max_slippage_bp: 'float | None' = None, ttl_ms: 'int | None' = None, reason: 'str' = '', trailing_stop: 'Level' = None, time_limit: 'Union[str, int, None]' = None)

name: reversed
doc:
This opening signal as a reverse: when the instance holds the opposite side, the order layer
closes it and then opens this one (the re-entry cooldown does not apply). Without an opposite
position it is a plain open.

name: bars
doc: Last n confirmed bars (cached within one event).

name: factors
doc: Fact-panel values of the last confirmed minute (missing → NaN); {} if unknown.

name: log
doc: A line in the instance's run log (shown on its card and in trial runs).

name: notify
doc:
Send a message to the owner's channels (Telegram, webhook) — live instances only; backtests
and trial runs keep it in the run log. At most 30 per hour; identical text once per 10 minutes.
Extra keyword arguments travel as data (webhook JSON, extra lines in Telegram).

name: position
doc: This instance's open position in inst, or None.

name: rank
sig: (rule: 'str', side: 'str' = 'long', among: 'list[str] | None' = None, min_score: 'float | None' = None, top: 'int | None' = None)
doc:
Instruments of the active pool ranked by a rule's score, best first. side: long | short | both
(each row then takes its stronger side). Rows: inst_id, side, score, long, short, values.
among limits the ranking to those instruments.

name: score
doc: (long, short) score of a rule, NaN when unscored.

name: screener
sig: (rule: 'str' = '', side: 'str' = 'long', top: 'int' = 20, min_score: 'float | None' = None, filter: 'dict | None' = None, scope: 'str' = 'pool')
doc:
Like Screener(...): scope="pool" ranks the active pool (by `rule` when given), scope="market"
every recorded crypto swap by 12h USDT turnover (no rule). Rows: inst_id, rank, last, long,
short, values; an unscored side is NaN (always for market rows).

name: series
doc:
Last n complete buckets of a data series (cached within one event):
oi (open interest USDT at the bucket close), funding (settled rates, one per settlement),
buy / sell / delta (taker buy, sell, buy − sell notional USDT).

name: submit
doc: Send a signal now (e.g. from on_fill); returns its id, or None if it was refused.

name: state
doc: dict persisted after every event (JSON, ≤ 64 KB), restored on restart

name: now
doc: host clock of the current event, ms (replay time in backtests)

name: mode
doc: "live" or "backtest"

name: params
doc: parameter values by name

name: universe
doc: current instruments of the instance

name: timeframe
doc: the instance's bar timeframe

name: instance_id
doc: id of the instance

name: Bar
sig: inst tf ts o h l c vol volq
doc: One confirmed candle of `inst` on `tf`; `ts` is the open time in ms.

name: Bars
sig: ts o h l c vol volq
doc: Columnar candles, oldest first: numpy arrays ts o h l c vol volq.

name: Series
doc: A data series, oldest first: numpy arrays ts (bucket open, ms) and v.

name: sma
doc: Simple moving average.

name: ema
doc: Exponential moving average, alpha = 2/(n+1).

name: rma
doc: Wilder's moving average, alpha = 1/n.

name: rsi
doc: Relative strength index (Wilder).

name: atr
doc: Average true range (RMA of true range).

name: tr
doc: True range; the first bar uses high - low.

name: macd
doc: Returns (macd, signal, histogram).

name: bbands
doc: Bollinger bands, Pine order: (middle, upper, lower).

name: bb
doc: Bollinger bands, Pine order: (middle, upper, lower).

name: crossover
doc: True where a crosses above b (b may be a scalar).

name: crossunder
doc: True where a crosses below b (b may be a scalar).

name: cross
doc: True where a crosses b in either direction.

name: highest
doc: Rolling maximum over n values.

name: lowest
doc: Rolling minimum over n values.

name: stdev
doc: Rolling population standard deviation (Pine's biased default).

name: change
doc: x - x[n bars ago].

name: Watchlist
doc:
Candidates being watched, stored in ctx.state[key] so they survive restarts.

Each entry: inst_id, side, score, since (ms, when it entered), plus anything you set with
update(ctx, inst, **fields).

name: Watchlist.sync
doc:
Bring the list in line with this round's candidates (rows with inst_id, side, score):
new ones enter with since = ctx.now, existing ones get the new score and side (a side change
restarts the clock), entries no longer among the candidates or watched longer than ttl_ms leave.
Returns the instruments that left.

name: Watchlist.items
doc: Entries, best score first.

name: pick
doc:
Choose which candidates (rows with inst_id, side, score) to open, best score first, so that
open positions plus new ones stay within max_total, and within max_side per side. Instruments
already held are skipped.
